note: Every edge function that releases Vireek-derived (aggregate or cross-tenant) data outside the owning tenant. Each MUST call assertDataProductApproved(<client>, <productKey>, <function>, ...) and the product MUST have a data_product_reviews path (seed or staff request). Enforced by scripts/data/check-data-product-gates.mjs. Tenant-directed exports and sharing (tenant-export, bi-*, exit-dataroom-public, financing-partner-*) are out of scope: the tenant is the data owner and initiates them.
